snippet.title: (Long Play) The Last Starfighter [ATARI 8-BIT] 🚀
snippet.description:
The Last Starfighter, Atari 1984 (Prototype), full long play. This was a never-released Beta which was eventually released in 1987 as "Star Raiders II". Pretty good looking game for it's time and a decent movie as well. The key is to make sure to recharge by warping to the sun. Just don't over-stay your welcome there as you'll melt down. 


#LastStarfighter #Atari8Bit #StarRaiders
